src/main.tsx: mounts App into index.html; a jsdom test of it would only repeat App's own tests
src/test/server.ts: the fake server the tests script; it answers only what the tests ask of it
src/test/render.tsx: mounts a page under a router for the tests; it is the harness, not the app
src/test/setup.ts: resets the browser between tests; it is the harness, not the app
src/test/fixtures.ts: builds sample data for the tests; it is the harness, not the app
src/test/Where.tsx: shows the router location so tests can see where a click went; it is the harness, not the app
